channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: ‘Rise up and fight’: Trump challenges Iranians as he claims US has ‘almost total control’ of Hormuz
item.description: Trump also appeared to directly call on the Iranian public to challenge the country’s leadership. “They are just playing out the inevitable. When are the Iranian people going to rise up and fight?” he wrote.

item.title: Bessent warns Iran’s global supporters: ‘Stay away’ or ‘we will put you out of business’
item.description: Bessent said the impact of the US pressure campaign is already being felt inside Iran. He pointed to hourslong queues at petrol stations, a sharply weakening currency, inflation above 100% and what he described as Iran’s inability to pay its military personnel.

item.title: Who is Maharaj Govinddev Giri? Ayodhya Ram Temple Trust appoints new general secretary, replacing Champat Rai
item.description: The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust appointed Govind Dev Giri as General Secretary and announced other organisational changes following a meeting. Giri succeeded Champat Rai amid a donation theft case, while retired Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra became the Trust’s first CEO.

item.title: Trump Administration’s latest birthright citizenship move: New passport rules proposed for parents of US-born children
item.description: US citizen parents could be asked to submit documents such as a valid US passport or birth certificate. Non-citizen parents could provide evidence including an I-94 form or a lawful permanent resident card.

item.title: ‘Failure to protect this temple is alarming’: India raises concerns over Narowal temple destruction
item.description: India has called for an investigation and restoration of a century-old Hindu temple in Pakistan's Narowal district after reports that the structure was destroyed, with New Delhi accusing the authorities of failing to protect a place of worship belonging to a religious minority.

item.title: Lose everything, keep this: Prakhar Gupta’s formula for building YouTube business from zero, earning your first ₹1 lakh
item.description: Podcaster Prakhar Gupta values skills and personal agency over fame. In a LiveMint interview, he discusses ambition, misconceptions about influencers and the importance of becoming useful.&nbsp;

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe's FDA crackdown continues: Box8, Mojo Pizza parent EatClub's Mumbai outlet loses licence—here's why
item.description: Tukaram Mundhe-led Maharashtra FDA suspended Box8's licence, citing violations of food safety regulations, including poor hygiene, inadequate storage, and lack of protective gear for staff. Additionally, Rani Diets' licence was revoked due to rodent activity and unsanitary conditions.

item.title: Trump administration weighs semiconductor tariffs; tech industry warns of AI setback
item.description: The proposed tariffs are being considered despite warnings from technology companies that higher costs and tighter access to advanced chips could undermine US ambitions to dominate the global artificial intelligence race.

item.title: 500 secret AI files and a China startup: Inside the case against ex-Google engineer Linwei Ding
item.description: Former Google engineer Linwei Ding was sentenced to nearly a year in prison for stealing trade secrets tied to the company’s AI technology. Despite initially facing multiple charges, his economic espionage conviction was overturned, but the court upheld trade-secrets convictions leading to sentence.

item.title: ‘The beast in your life should be you’: Ankur Warikoo says the ‘strongest investments’ cannot be taken away
item.description: Ankur Warikoo emphasises personal growth and resilience in his LinkedIn post, highlighting that real skills and mindset are crucial during setbacks.&nbsp;

item.title: Goyal to visit US for trade talks this month, says US ambassador Gor
item.description: India and the US seek deeper trade ties as they expand cooperation on critical minerals, technology and resilient supply chain

item.title: Tiger Woods gets 5-year driving ban after Florida crash; DUI charge dropped
item.description: The 50-year-old golf superstar pleaded no contest to lesser charges of careless and reckless driving, while the more serious DUI charge he initially faced was dropped under the agreement.

item.title: Delhi SIR: Why 33% of voters excluded? Which 13 seats saw highest deletions? Check if you are one of them
item.description: The CEO Delhi revealed that 67.22% of voters were successfully enumerated in the SIR phase, but nearly 33% were excluded. The exclusions include deceased and duplicate entries. Affected citizens can rectify their status from 31 August to 30 September 2026, according to the CEO's office.

item.title: Heavy rain likely across north, central and east India over the next few days
item.description: The IMD has forecast a low to moderate flash-flood risk over several watersheds and neighbourhoods in east Madhya Pradesh in east Uttar Pradesh.

item.title: Ram Mandir CEO News: Meet Jitendra Mishra from UP’s Deoria - Who is he? His connection with Operation Sindoor?
item.description: Jitendra Mishra, a former IAF officer and commanding chief during Operation Sindoor, has been appointed as the first CEO of the Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir in Ayodhya. The selection involved screening 5,585 applications.&nbsp;

item.title: One wrong tap, ₹37,000 gone: Uber driver returns money sent by mistake, refuses to take reward
item.description: The Uber driver mistakenly received ₹37,000 via Google Pay. He promptly returned the money but refused to accept any reward. Here's why.

item.title: Govt bodies can't seek old dues after IBC process completed: Delhi HC in Jaiprakash case
item.description: Delhi High Court ruled that government agencies must file claims during insolvency proceedings and cannot recover old dues after approval of a resolution plan. It quashed Customs’ ₹5.89 lakh demand against Jaiprakash Associates, reinforcing the IBC’s ‘clean slate’ principle.

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe's FDA action: Maggi, Lay’s, Kurkure packs found with fake expiry dates in Mumbai were meant for export
item.description: A raid by the Maharashtra FDA uncovered a Mumbai warehouse reportedly modifying packaging details of food products, including altering original expiry dates of Lay's potato chips, Kurkure and Maggi noodles. The seized materials amounted to approximately $80,000.&nbsp;

item.title: Historic milestone for Indian Air Force- Amazing feat by Air Vice Marshal Shakti Sharma; 1st woman to achieve this
item.description: Air Vice Marshal Shakti Sharma is the first woman to become non-medical Air Vice Marshal in Indian Air Force, marking the beginning of a new era. Previously, she was the first woman officer from the Tri-Services to command a Sainik School.

item.title: Lollapalooza India 2027 tickets now on sale: Check price, time and booking guide
item.description: Lollapalooza India 2027 ticket sales opened at 11 am IST on September 2. The two-day Mumbai festival takes place on January 23 and 24, with tickets currently listed from ₹6,999 and Olivia Dean confirmed as a headline act.

item.title: Apple, Google rename Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’ for US users after Trump’s order: Were they legally bound to comply?
item.description: Apple and Google updated their Maps apps for US users to show Lake Ontario as 'Lake America' after President Trump ordered the name changed in the US government’s GNIS database. Private companies are not legally bound by the order, and MapQuest kept “Lake Ontario.”

item.title: Quote of the day by Dalai Lama: ‘If you think you are too small to make a difference, try…’
item.description: LiveMint's quote of the day by spiritual leader Dalai Lama uses a vivid, relatable metaphor to illustrate that scale does not dictate impact.

item.title: $1 trillion Afghan mineral wealth: Is Taliban offering access to American investors? What's the deal behind it?
item.description: Five years after the Taliban took control of Afghanistan, Kabul is seeking closer US ties by offering American investors access to its mineral wealth, while seeking sanctions relief and the release of frozen Afghan assets.

item.title: Unusual episode at Ram Mandir: Devotee from Chennai with ₹3 in bank gave ₹4-cr cheque but donated ₹10k separately
item.description: As per reports, the woman, who is based out of Coimbatore, wanted the ₹4 crore she claimed she was donating to be used for the benefit of the workers of the temple.

item.title: ‘Rich Dad Poor Dad’ self-help author Robert Kiyosaki is $1.2 billion in debt, but...
item.description: The massive debt figure is widely misunderstood, said his ex-wife and business partner, Kim Kiyosaki.

item.title: 40,000 pounds of beer vanishes in US: Company offers reward to solve mystery, internet reacts
item.description: Pabst Brewing Company says thieves used false documentation to collect a shipment of 40,000 pounds of Pabst Blue Ribbon beer from a California distribution centre.&nbsp;

item.title: Subhash Chandra opposes NCLT’s five-member bench as creditors’ appeal remains pending in NCLAT
item.description: Subhash Chandra challenges NCLT’s five-member bench in his insolvency case, while NCLAT keeps lenders’ challenge to his repayment plan alive and will hear the matter on 7 October.

item.title: Joshua Wong pleads guilty: What is the second national security case against the Hong Kong activist?
item.description: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleaded guilty to a second national security case over alleged collusion with foreign forces to seek sanctions against China and Hong Kong. Wong is already serving a 4-year, 8-month prison sentence.

item.title: Harsh Goenka backs civic sense debate after Indian tourists’ Germany bus video: ‘We must respect local etiquette’
item.description: A video of Indian tourists singing and clapping loudly on a crowded public bus in Germany has sparked an online debate over civic sense and public behaviour. Industrialist Harsh Goenka weighed in, urging travellers to respect local etiquette.

item.title: Nepal Urges Tourists Not to Abandon Himalayas After Floods
item.description: Nepal urged international travelers not to abandon the Himalayas, declaring the country open for tourism as it continues to assess the human and economic toll from catastrophic floods that killed hundreds and left thousands missing.

item.title: ‘Is this a red flag?’: Boss asks about sales closure after employee’s mom is hospitalised
item.description: An employee turned to Reddit after her director responded to news of her mother’s emergency hospitalisation by asking about the month-end sales closure. The post sparked a debate over workplace empathy, delayed salaries and unpaid incentives.

item.title: Who is Hung Cao? Trump nominates combat veteran who served in Iraq, Afghanistan as US Navy secretary
item.description: US President Donald Trump nominated Hung Cao to become the permanent US Navy Secretary, praising his leadership of the Navy and Marine Corps. Cao, a combat veteran and former special operations officer, has been serving as acting secretary since April.

item.title: Iran war news LIVE: Trump floats renaming Strait of Hormuz ‘Trump Strait’ amid Iran war
item.description: Iran war news LIVE: “Now that we have it under U.S.A. control, should we change the name Hormuz Strait to TRUMP STRAIT??? Like America itself, it would be 'hotter' than ever before!” Trump said on his Truth Social network.

item.title: ‘Like winning crores': TN CM Vijay places his Dior Sunglasses on elderly woman in heartwarming viral video | Watch
item.description: Despite Chellam's initial reluctance, Vijay gently persuaded the eldery woman before placing the Christian Dior sunglasses on her face himself - a cinema-like gesture from the former silver-screen hero, who quit acting and took to full-time politics to serve the people.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today — 2 September: Check fuel rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: Over the past 10 days, Mumbai petrol prices have ranged from ₹111.21 to ₹117.61 per litre
